# La Grocerie du Gründ

> Sandwicherie artisanale, épicerie fermière et cave à vins naturels au cœur du Gründ, Luxembourg.

La Grocerie du Gründ is a neighbourhood food destination in Luxembourg-Grund combining three concepts under one roof: Mezzocuore (artisan sandwich shop), L'Épicerie (farm grocery), and La Cave de la Grocerie (natural wine cellar).

## Key Information

- **Address**: 12 Rue Münster, L-2160 Luxembourg-Grund
- **Email**: info@lagrocerie.lu
- **Instagram**: @lagroceriegrund
- **Website**: https://www.lagrocerie.lu
- **Hours**: Tue–Sat 10:00–18:00, Sun 10:00–16:00, Mon Closed
- **Languages**: French (primary), English, German, Luxembourgish
